afd.snippet: 000 FXUS65 KGJT 270038 AFDGJT Area Forecast Discussion National Weather Service Grand Junction CO 638 PM MDT Sun Jul 26 2026 .KEY MESSAGES... - A Heat Advisory is in effect for many of the lower desert valleys of Eastern Utah and Western Colorado through Tuesday morning for triple digit highs and extremely mild overnight lows in the 70s and 80s. - Showers and storms will develop each afternoon/eve

fwf.snippet: .DISCUSSION...Not much change from the past several days with hot temperatures and daily afternoon thunderstorm threats. These temperatures may allow humidity in localized areas to drop into the teens...but overall winds will remain light away from thunderstorms. Brief moderate to heavy rainfall rates from storms and gusty outflow winds remain threats. If these downpours move over burn scars...deb

alerts.title: I-70 Glenwood Canyon bridge joints-138574
alerts.description: Between Exit 116: CO 82; Glenwood Springs/Aspen (near Glenwood Springs) and Exit 133: Dotsero (2 miles west of the Dotsero area) from Mile Point 118.1 to Mile Point 129.9. Bridge construction. Starting July 28, 2026 at 7:00AM MDT until July 28, 2026 at about 7:00PM MDT. Full schedule below: • July 28, 7:00AM - July 28, 7:00PM Comment: Westbound I-70 will be reduced to one lane from near the Bair Ranch Rest Area (Exit 129) at 128.5 and before the Hanging Lake Rest Area (Exit 125), MP 126.5, to just for work on three bridge joints. Eastbound I-70 will be reduced to one lane from near the Shoshone Rest Area (Exit 123), MP 123, to the Hanging Lake Rest Area (Exit 125) for an additional three bridge joints. Daytime work hours will be 7 a.m. to 7 p.m., Monday through Friday. The speed limit will be reduced to 35 mph through the work zone.
